mxCell.value: Cấu trúc MongoDB collections theo code hiện có

articles _id: ObjectId link: String, unique theo logic crawl title: String description: String, nullable content: String hoặc Array/Text status: String, ví dụ crawled crawled_at: DateTime videos: Array[String] image: String, nullable images: Array[String] thumbnail_url: String, nullable preview_url: String, nullable source_platform: String, ví dụ vnexpress/bilibili crawl_source: String requested_topics: Array[String] author: String, nullable play_count: Number, nullable duration_seconds: Integer, nullable episode_count: Integer, nullable episodes: Array[episode] series_source: String, nullable season_id: String/Number, nullable season_title: String, nullable bvid: String, nullable aid: Number, nullable
episode embedded trong articles.episodes episode_index: Number title: String url: String duration_seconds: Integer, nullable bvid: String, nullable aid: Number, nullable cid: Number, nullable

user_crawl_settings _id: ObjectId user_id: Integer keywords: Array[String] exclude_keywords: Array[String] min_score: Integer, default 70, 0..100 include_low_suggestions: Boolean, default true use_ai_scoring: Boolean, default true recent_limit: Integer, default 50, 1..200 updated_at: DateTime

user_article_feeds _id: ObjectId user_id: Integer link: String, tham chiếu articles.link article: Object nhúng bản sao article score: Integer, 0..100 match_status: String, matched/low_suggestion reason: String/Text matched_keywords: Array[String] matched_at: DateTime

publish_log _id: ObjectId published_at: DateTime user_id: Integer, nếu payload có article_link: String, nếu payload có platform: String, nếu payload có profile_id: Integer, nếu payload có success/result/error/caption: theo payload publisher

user_topic_crawls _id: ObjectId Collection đã khai báo lazy proxy Dùng cho lịch sử/yêu cầu crawl theo chủ đề nếu được mở rộng Trường dự kiến từ event: request_id, user_id, topics, exclude_keywords, limit, source, requested_at

video_localization_jobs _id: ObjectId id: String UUID/job id user_id: Integer source_url: String title: String, nullable status: String stage/progress: workflow fields output_video: String, nullable error_message/error: String, nullable created_at: DateTime updated_at: DateTime Các field trung gian do process_video_localization_job cập nhật
scheduler_settings _id: String, global vnexpress_interval_minutes: Integer, 1..1440 bilibili_interval_minutes: Integer, 1..1440 publish_queue_interval_minutes: Integer, 1..1440
